entries.title: 1943: The Battle of Midway

emulation.emulator: Capcom Arcade Stadium wrapper for primary
emulation.notes: MAME only for comparison if official routes are unavailable.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Capcom Arcade Stadium PC capture or original arcade hardware

primary.version: 1943: The Battle of Midway through Capcom Arcade Stadium
primary.why: 1943 is a Capcom arcade shooter, and Capcom Arcade Stadium is the current official arcade-preservation route with PC capture, display options, and documented game selection.
primary.how_to_play: Use Capcom Arcade Stadium on PC. Record collection/version, display/filter/cabinet settings, difficulty, lives, rewind/save-assist use, score route, and whether original arcade hardware or NES/home ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for exact historical arcade preservation.
secondary.why: PC Arcade Stadium is easier to capture, but original hardware is the reference artifact.
The arcade version is the primary game identity.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record collection settings and avoid mixing home-port scoring or balance with arcade scoring.
